name: Scenic Half Marathon Krabi 2026
short_description: A half marathon with a 10 km, run on 13 September 2026 from Krabi Provincial Stadium in Ao Nang to Noppharat Thara Beach, Krabi, Thailand, with 5 km and 3 km beach runs on 12 September.
ai_summary: The Scenic Half Marathon Krabi 2026 was held over the weekend of 12 and 13 September 2026 in Ao Nang, Krabi, Thailand. The 21.1 km half marathon and the 10 km ran point to point on Sunday 13 September from Krabi Provincial Stadium to Noppharat Thara Beach, and 5 km and 3 km beach runs were held on Saturday evening. RACEUP WORK Co., Ltd. organised it.

core_facts.organizer: RACEUP WORK Co., Ltd. (Scenic Marathon Series)
core_facts.venue: Start Krabi Provincial Stadium, Ao Nang; finish Noppharat Thara Beach

pros: Point-to-point route from Ao Nang to Noppharat Thara Beach, with shuttles back
Three and a half hours for the half marathon, with water every 2 km
Four distances over two days, including 5 km and 3 km beach runs
Generous finish area: medal, food coupon, ice cream, and a finisher shirt for the half
cons: 100% humidity and no wind at the 2026 start
182 m of climbing, concentrated between km 7 and km 16
Race packs can only be collected the day before the race
Entry fees are not refunded even if the race is cancelled

research_highlights: The half marathon (21.1km) started at 04:30 and the 10km 'Road Run' at 05:00, both at Krabi Provincial Stadium in Ao Nang, finishing at Noppharat Thara Beach National Park.
A separate late-afternoon 'Beach Run' (5km/3km) is held the evening before along the coastal road at Noppharat Thara Beach.
September in Krabi means high heat and humidity; one participant described conditions as 'crazy hot' with humidity over 80% and temperatures near 30°C.

The course runs along Ao Nang's coastline with views of limestone cliffs and the Andaman Sea, and the event draws a notable international crowd (runners from the UK, Russia, and New Zealand have been reported).
The 2026 edition is being promoted as the first World Athletics Road Race Label-certified race in Southern Thailand, as part of the wider Scenic Marathon Series.
research_watchouts: Heat and humidity are a significant challenge even with the pre-dawn start — one runner called it 'crazy hot' and said the tropical humidity made eating and pacing difficult.
Runners not acclimatized to tropical heat may need to adjust pace expectations and take walk breaks at water stations, as one participant did every two kilometers.
Very early wake-up times (start around 4:30am) require logistics planning, such as booking accommodation with race-day shuttle access.

faqs.question: When was the Scenic Half Marathon Krabi 2026?
faqs.answer: The Scenic Half Marathon Krabi 2026 was held on 12 and 13 September 2026. The 5 km and 3 km beach runs started at 5.30pm and 5.40pm on Saturday 12 September, and the half marathon and 10 km started at 4.30am and 5am on Sunday 13 September.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The half marathon and 10 km started at Krabi Provincial Stadium in Ao Nang and finished at Noppharat Thara Beach, in the Noppharat Thara–Mu Ko Phi Phi National Park, so the course was point to point, with shuttles back. The Saturday beach runs started and finished at Noppharat Thara Beach.

faqs.question: What distance options are available for this race?
faqs.answer: The event offered four distances over two days: a 21.1 km half marathon and a 10 km road run on Sunday, and 5 km and 3 km beach runs on Saturday evening. The half marathon was the main race, with a limit of three and a half hours and 2,500 places.
